info.title: SGLang rawsystemone API
info.description: Standalone contract for the native scoring endpoint from sglang_rawsystemone_spec_v1_2.md. Generated from the implemented Pydantic models with wire-format and semantic annotations. Regenerate with python scripts/export_rawsystemone_openapi.py.

servers.description: Example local SGLang server; replace with your deployment URL.

post.description: Tokenize the prefix once and append each option's tokens encoded with add_special_tokens=false. Prefill the fixed prefix before parallel option evaluation when cache reuse is useful. Compute each suffix's conditional log-probability sum, divide by its option token count, and apply softmax across the original options. Prefix token scores contribute to neither numerator nor denominator. Uses the already-loaded default model; no generation, streaming, model selection, or sampling parameters. Server limits apply to the number of options, each candidate's native context length, and total logical candidate tokens (default 1,048,576, including duplicates). Internal batching and concurrency are configured by the server.

example.prefix:
Customer: Please move my appointment to Friday.

The requested operation is

200.description: Complete scores for every candidate. All scores are finite; failures return an error instead of a partial result. Example values are illustrative, not measured model outputs.

401.description: Missing or invalid bearer API key when server authentication is enabled.

400.description: Invalid fields, types, JSON, or Content-Type (invalid_request); unsupported serving configuration (unsupported_mode); or candidate limits (too_many_options, no_prefix_tokens, no_option_tokens, no_scoreable_tokens, context_length_exceeded, token_budget_exceeded). No candidate is silently truncated. Validation uses HTTP 400, not 422.

409.description: Model weights changed during scoring (model_changed). Retry the whole request.

429.description: The admission queue or native scheduler is overloaded (overloaded).

500.description: Incomplete native score coverage (incomplete_scores), non-finite scores (non_finite_scores), or native inference failure (inference_error).

503.description: The native tokenizer is unavailable (tokenizer_unavailable), or native inference is overloaded (overloaded).

504.description: The server-configured scoring deadline expired (timeout); default 300 seconds.

default.description: Other HTTP failure propagated from native inference (inference_error).

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Prompt text tokenized once using the native raw-text policy, without inserted whitespace or a chat template. The resulting prefix must contain at least one token; an empty string is valid only when the native tokenizer supplies a token such as BOS.

suffixes.title: Suffixes
suffixes.description: Ordered candidate suffixes. Duplicates are allowed. Each suffix must tokenize to at least one token without tokenizer-added special tokens. Each complete prefix + suffix must have at least two native tokens. The server-configured option limit defaults to 128; it is not a fixed schema limit.

return_token_logprobs.title: Return Token Logprobs
return_token_logprobs.description: Include complete native token records for every candidate. When false, token_logprobs is omitted from every result.

index.title: Index
index.description: Zero-based index in the request's suffixes array.

score.title: Score
score.description: Normalized weight: softmax(logprob_sum / option_token_count) across all original options, including duplicates. Weights sum to one within floating-point precision. This is not calibrated correctness confidence.

logprob_sum.title: Logprob Sum
logprob_sum.description: Natural log P(suffix | prefix): sum of suffix-token log-probabilities. Equivalent to the complete sequence log-probability minus the fixed prefix log-probability; prefix token scores are excluded.

option_token_count.title: Option Token Count
option_token_count.description: Token count of this suffix encoded alone with add_special_tokens=false, preserving its exact whitespace. This is the score denominator, independent of prefix length and shared cache span.

token_logprobs.title: Token Logprobs
token_logprobs.description: Present only when return_token_logprobs is true. Contains every token in the complete prefix + suffix in absolute position order, including position zero. Its length is not the score denominator.

position.title: Position
position.description: Zero-based absolute position in the complete native token sequence.

token_id.title: Token Id
token_id.description: Native tokenizer token ID at this position.

logprob.title: Logprob
logprob.description: Natural log-probability after full-vocabulary log-softmax. Null only at position zero; every later position has a finite value, including a possible 0.0. This is not a raw logit.

input_tokens.title: Input Tokens
input_tokens.description: Total native tokens in all complete prefix + suffix sequences, including repeated prefixes and duplicate candidates.

scored_tokens.title: Scored Tokens
scored_tokens.description: Total scoreable tokens in all complete sequences: input_tokens minus the number of candidates. This is not the sum of option_token_count.

generated_tokens.title: Generated Tokens
generated_tokens.description: Always zero; the endpoint does not generate tokens.

model.title: Model
model.description: The already-loaded default model's served name.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.description: For each option, divide log P(suffix | prefix) by option_token_count, then apply a numerically stable softmax across all original options.

tokenization.title: Tokenization
tokenization.description: Tokenize the prefix once with native raw-text special-token behavior, tokenize each suffix with add_special_tokens=false, and append the token IDs. This fixes the prefix boundary and can differ from tokenizing the concatenated text.

data.title: Data
data.description: One result per original suffix, in input order, including duplicates.

best_index.title: Best Index
best_index.description: Zero-based original index with the highest score. Exact ties select the first index; scores are not rounded before selection.

usage.description: Logical candidate totals, including repeated prefixes and duplicate candidates. These do not measure physical GPU work or cache savings.

type.description: Machine-readable error type; see response descriptions.

example.message: Invalid rawsystemone fields or field types.

BearerAuth.description: Use Authorization: Bearer <api-key>. Required when the server is configured with --api-key; otherwise anonymous requests are accepted. This is an API key, not necessarily a JWT.
